newsitem.title: CYPRUS: SOCCER-ANORTHOSIS FAMAGUSTA WIN CYPRUS LEAGUE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ANORTHOSIS FAMAGUSTA WIN CYPRUS LEAGUE.

text.p: Anorthosis Famagusta have won the 1997 Cyprus championship and will play in the European Cup next season.
Anorthosis sealed the title with 65 points and 20 victories from their 26 matches.
Apollon Limassol, with 52 points and 16 wins, finished as runners-up will play in the UEFA Cup.
Olympiakos of Nicosia, Aris of Limassol and APEP Pitsilias were relegated to the second division and will be replaced by AEL of Limassol, Evagoras of Paphos and Ethnikos Assias.
The season is due to end on Saturday with the cup final between Nicosia rivals Omonia and APOEL.
